title: Season One
label: Raptor Records / Folk's Worst Nightmare

description.de: Das Full-Band-Debüt: acht Songs zwischen Indie, Folk und Punk, aufgenommen in Nürnberg und als Vinyl-LP mit Textbeilage, Downloadcode und dem Sticker „kein mensch ist illegal“ erschienen.
description.en: The full-band debut: eight songs between indie, folk and punk, recorded in Nuremberg and released as a vinyl LP with a lyric sheet, a download code and a “kein mensch ist illegal” sticker.

credits: Recorded, mixed and mastered by Andreas Wieland and Philipp Thönes
Released by Raptor Records and Folk's Worst Nightmare

tracks.title: The Coming Up Whatever
tracks.lyrics: There were always the forgotten ones, who were hiding from the future, shocked and overwhelmed by malicious and nefarious schemes. There were always constant seekers, which the time could not hold back, waiting so impatiently for someone to join the track. Well, I don’t know much but apparently they should hang out together. There have always been the voices that repeated the folly of some charlatans in parrot fashion, “straight white male is coming on”. They haven’t met the many addicts who are absorbing the world and life in themselves and learn to share the best world they could describe. Well, I don’t’ know much but apparently they should hang out together. I don’t wanna sound naive but I’m sure we sort out the coming up whatever. There have always been the ones who blossomed out in storm and dust, in rebellion and resistance against hypocrisy and breach of trust. They never had a drink or two with the anxious and oppressed, the less brave but not at all less worthy silent rest. Well, I don’t know much but apparently they should hang out together. I don’t wanna sound naive but I’m sure we sort out the coming up whatever. Well, I don’t know much but apparently they should hang out together. Well, I’m not quite sure but, as far as I can see, we stand and fall, eat and starve, hush and sing best together. To the coming up whatever.

tracks.title: It's Okay
tracks.lyrics: you can come in now, guess I calmed down enough to talk. Well, this might not excuse a thing, but all I’ve done was to try to make things right what I still do. While you keep on telling lies what you always do. It’s quiet now ... show more or it seems to be, I feel it right beneath my skin and I can smell the fire coming closer. The hypocrites sing their songs of indifference backed up by the coward’s elite, but they all feel the fire coming closer. It’s okay, we can talk it out, guess I already know your points.
